USOL10 — Starting selection brief
Manufacturer: Boya Gongdao

An 11 m unmanned observation vessel for coastal and offshore monitoring, carrying multibeam, ADCP, CTD and water samplers, with an optional two-person manual mode.

Length: 11 m
Full-load displacement: 8 t
Cruise speed: 8 kn (4.1 m/s)
Endurance: 200 min at 8 kn (to confirm)
Manual mode: Crewed operation for 2 people
Communication: Radio and satellite, multi-mode
Payload wells: Multibeam, ADCP, CTD, water sampler
Weather sensors: Optional weather station

Configuration note: The manufacturer describes closed-loop operation from mission planning to data return, sea-state tolerance and multi-payload observation. A manual mode allows two crew on board. Communication, payload and operating mode are configured per project.

Confirm current specifications and delivered scope with the manufacturer before purchase.
